notes: Background: mid-market CS platform (B2B SaaS) with European HQ; embedding & chat features planned for product support and knowledge base retrieval.
Pilot path: wants to start on Hosted API to move fast, then evaluate Dedicated pools in EU for predictable latency and data residency.
Quote (CTO): 'EU-only storage and processing is a hard req — GDPR + customer contracts. We also need multi-region routing so EU traffic stays in EU.'
Latency targets: P95 < 350ms for support chat flows (short context), peak throughput ~300 RPS during release day; cost sensitivity — wants cost projection for hosted vs dedicated.
POC ask: 2-week EU-dedicated POC with sample traffic, region pinning, and fallback policy to Redwood Hosted in US for global non-EU traffic. Measure tail latencies and token cost.
Security: requires SSO/SAML for console, audit_logging retention 1 year, integration with customer KMS for key wrapping on Private later (but currently evaluating Dedicated).
Technical concerns discussed: multi-region KV cache behavior, prefix caching consistency, cross-region cold starts, sequence-length distribution impacts on kernel selection.
Routing preference: prefer policy-based routing by user tenancy/region header with automatic fallback to nearest available variant — will need clarifications on routing configs and cost impact.

Pricing: wants three scenarios — pure Hosted (projected tokens/month), Hybrid (hosted + EU-dedicated routing), and Dedicated reserved (monthly commit). Asked for a 12-month ARR model and overage fees.

Customer comment (Head of Ops): 'If Dedicated reduces per-token cost by 20% at our scale, it's an easy win — but we need comfort on failover behavior.'
